combo_label: Farms & Farming × Sewing & Knitting × Ancient Egypt

entries.clue: Wide green acres kept under grass, where the cattle graze all summer long
Line where two pieces of cloth are joined, then pressed open flat
Stone from a Delta town whose three scripts unlocked the glyphs
Ribbed cotton with velvety ridges running down its length, a trouser standby
Ibis-headed patron of scribes and reckoning
Translucent white stone cut into vessels and lamps
Jackal-headed guardian who weighed hearts against a feather
Long open vessel the pigs shove at and the cattle drink from
Two huge rear tyres, two small at the front, and a cab that tows the lot
Band finishing a sleeve at the wrist, turned back or closed with a link
Work a threaded point in and out of cloth to fasten two edges together
The ram's mate, and mother to every new arrival in the fold
God of storms and disorder who murdered his own brother
